value.healthSummary: Gmail business operations require an owner-connected OAuth account.

argumentsMetadata.name: Email retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: Search bounded email metadata, threads, and attachment references.

argumentsMetadata.name: Email drafts
argumentsMetadata.description: Create a bounded draft without sending it.

argumentsMetadata.name: Approved email send
argumentsMetadata.description: Send, reply, or forward one reviewed message with idempotent verification.

value.healthSummary: CRM operations use finite lead read and mutation capabilities.

argumentsMetadata.name: CRM retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: Search contacts, companies, leads, pipeline, and activity through bounded reads.

argumentsMetadata.name: Lead updates
argumentsMetadata.description: Create leads, update stages, append notes, or create a mapped follow-up after review.

value.healthSummary: Support tickets use reviewed reads, drafts, replies, assignment, status, notes, and escalation.

argumentsMetadata.name: Ticket retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: List, search, and read bounded support tickets.

argumentsMetadata.name: Response drafts
argumentsMetadata.description: Create a response draft without contacting the customer.

argumentsMetadata.name: Approved support reply
argumentsMetadata.description: Send a reviewed customer response.

argumentsMetadata.name: Ticket workflow updates
argumentsMetadata.description: Change status, assignment, notes, or escalation after review.

value.healthSummary: Documents remain external source-of-truth records and are never copied wholesale into memory.

argumentsMetadata.name: Document retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: Find and read explicitly authorized documents.

argumentsMetadata.name: Document changes
argumentsMetadata.description: Create, update, or attach a document reference after review.

value.healthSummary: Project tasks map to stable Athena task references without duplicating external truth.

argumentsMetadata.name: Project and task retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: List projects, search, and read bounded tasks.

argumentsMetadata.name: Project task updates
argumentsMetadata.description: Create or update a mapped external task after review.

value.healthSummary: Analytics exposes validated metric windows only, never arbitrary queries.

argumentsMetadata.name: Metric observations
argumentsMetadata.description: Read registered metrics, dimensions, funnels, cohorts, events, and explicit periods without arbitrary provider queries.

value.healthSummary: Provider-neutral accounting reads and draft-only changes; finalized books are not mutable.

argumentsMetadata.name: Accounting retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: Read bounded accounts, transactions, reports, invoices, bills, aging, and periods.

argumentsMetadata.name: Accounting drafts
argumentsMetadata.description: Create or update reviewable drafts and notes; no finalized-ledger mutation.

argumentsMetadata.name: Accounting review notes
argumentsMetadata.description: Add bounded notes or mark records for human review.

value.healthSummary: Money movement is separate from Athena credits and always requires recent-authenticated exact-action approval.

argumentsMetadata.name: Payment retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: Read bounded payment, payout, subscription, and dispute state.

argumentsMetadata.name: Payment preparation
argumentsMetadata.description: Prepare a bounded charge, refund, or subscription change without moving money.

argumentsMetadata.name: Payment execution
argumentsMetadata.description: Execute one version-bound charge/refund or cancellation after step-up approval.

value.healthSummary: Ad reads, drafts, and spend-affecting mutations are finite and separately governed.

argumentsMetadata.name: Campaign analytics
argumentsMetadata.description: Read campaigns, bounded performance, spend, conversion, creative, and audience summaries.

argumentsMetadata.name: Campaign drafts
argumentsMetadata.description: Create or update campaign and creative drafts without activating spend.

argumentsMetadata.name: Governed campaign changes
argumentsMetadata.description: Version-bound pause/resume and budget changes with financial-impact preview.

value.healthSummary: Commerce data remains provider truth; inventory, price, discount, refund, and cancellation paths are bounded.

argumentsMetadata.name: Commerce retrieval
argumentsMetadata.description: Read bounded products, inventory, customers, orders, fulfillment, and returns.

argumentsMetadata.name: Commerce preparation
argumentsMetadata.description: Prepare bounded discounts and refunds without moving money.

argumentsMetadata.name: Governed commerce changes
argumentsMetadata.description: Version-bound product, inventory, note, and cancellation actions.

value.healthSummary: Slack connector installed; message sending remains approval-gated.

argumentsMetadata.name: Workflow notifications
